set -e
cmake -S . -B build/m3-sdk -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/workspace/install/srt-m0 -DBUILD_MANAGEMENT_CODEC=ON -DBUILD_SRT_TRANSPORT=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
cmake --build build/m3-sdk --parallel 3
ctest --test-dir build/m3-sdk --output-on-failure --parallel 3
cmake --install build/m3-sdk --prefix /workspace/install/bridge-m3
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
colcon --log-base .local/m3-session-sensor-build/colcon-build build --cmake-clean-first --base-paths ros2 --build-base build/m3-ros --install-base install/m3-ros --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release '-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/workspace/install/bridge-m3;/workspace/install/srt-m0'
source install/m3-ros/setup.bash
colcon --log-base .local/m3-session-sensor-build/colcon-test test --base-paths ros2 --build-base build/m3-ros --install-base install/m3-ros --return-code-on-test-failure
colcon test-result --test-result-base build/m3-ros --verbose
